name: markitdown
description: Python tool for converting files and office documents to Markdown.
one_liner: A tool that takes almost any file — a Word doc, PDF, PowerPoint, Excel sheet, even a scanned image — and converts it into clean, readable text that AI tools can actually understand.
buyer: An operations lead at a mid-size company who needs to feed years of scattered PDFs, contracts, and slide decks into an internal AI search tool or chatbot.
business_use_cases: A law firm converts thousands of scanned contracts and PDFs into searchable text so their internal AI assistant can answer questions across the archive.
An HR consultancy builds a resume-screening service that ingests documents of any format and normalizes them before running AI analysis.
A market research firm automatically converts client-submitted PowerPoint decks and Excel data into a unified format for its AI summarization pipeline.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a hosted document-conversion API with volume-based pricing for companies that don't want to run or maintain the Python package themselves.
Bundle it into a 'company knowledge base setup' consulting package: ingest a client's file shares, convert everything, and hand over a ready-to-use AI search tool.

steal_this: Build a simple drag-and-drop web app: upload any file, get back clean Markdown, and offer a paid tier for batch folder uploads — a weekend wrapper around a well-tested library.
